# Custom music tests (dekp23). Standalone:
#   cmake -S tools/skate3_music_import/tests/cpp -B build-music-tests \
#         [-DSKATE3_TEST_MUSIC_DIR=<game>/data/audio/music]
#   cmake --build build-music-tests && ctest --test-dir build-music-tests --output-on-failure
# or from the repo root with -DSKATE3_CUSTOM_MUSIC_TESTS=ON.
# The modules under test are plain C++17 (no rexglue build needed). Tests that need the
# game's music files run only when SKATE3_TEST_MUSIC_DIR is set; their index and replay
# data are generated by fixtures with the Python tool (python3, no packages).
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
  project(skate3_custom_music_tests CXX)
  enable_testing()
endif()

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
get_filename_component(_repo "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../.." ABSOLUTE)
set(_src "${_repo}/src")
set(_tool "${_repo}/tools/skate3_music_import")
set(SKATE3_JSON_INCLUDE "${_repo}/third_party/rexglue-sdk/thirdparty/inja/third_party/include"
    CACHE PATH "Folder containing nlohmann/json.hpp")
set(_json "${SKATE3_JSON_INCLUDE}")
set(SKATE3_TEST_MUSIC_DIR "" CACHE PATH "Game data/audio/music folder for data-driven tests")
find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
find_package(Python3 COMPONENTS Interpreter)

add_library(custom_music_core STATIC
  ${_src}/skate3_custom_music.cpp
  ${_src}/skate3_custom_music_player.cpp
  ${_src}/skate3_custom_music_mus.cpp
  ${_src}/skate3_custom_music_mpf.cpp
  ${_src}/skate3_custom_music_library.cpp
  ${_src}/skate3_custom_music_metadata.cpp
)
target_include_directories(custom_music_core PUBLIC ${_src} ${_json})
target_link_libraries(custom_music_core PUBLIC Threads::Threads)
if(NOT MSVC)
  target_compile_options(custom_music_core PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra)
endif()

foreach(_t test_player test_metadata test_custom_music test_integration test_library test_mpf test_mus)
  add_executable(custom_music_${_t} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${_t}.cpp)
  target_link_libraries(custom_music_${_t} PRIVATE custom_music_core)
endforeach()

set(_work "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/work")

# Always: no game files needed.
add_test(NAME custom_music_player COMMAND custom_music_test_player ${_work}/player)
add_test(NAME custom_music_metadata COMMAND custom_music_test_metadata)
add_test(NAME custom_music_engine_unit COMMAND custom_music_test_custom_music)
if(Python3_FOUND)
  add_test(NAME custom_music_python
           COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} -m unittest discover -s tests
           WORKING_DIRECTORY ${_tool})
endif()

# With the game's music files.
if(SKATE3_TEST_MUSIC_DIR AND Python3_FOUND)
  set(_m "${SKATE3_TEST_MUSIC_DIR}")
  set(_lib "${_work}/library")
  add_test(NAME custom_music_fixture_data
           COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory ${_lib})
  add_test(NAME custom_music_fixture_index
           COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} ${_tool}/skate3_music_import.py index ${_m}/ipod.mpf
                   --out ${_lib}/ipod.s3fp)
  add_test(NAME custom_music_fixture_sim
           COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} ${_tool}/tests/sim_stream.py ${_m}/ipod.mpf
                   ${_m}/game.mpf ${_work}/sim.bin)
  set_tests_properties(custom_music_fixture_data PROPERTIES FIXTURES_SETUP music_data)
  set_tests_properties(custom_music_fixture_index custom_music_fixture_sim PROPERTIES
                       FIXTURES_SETUP music_data DEPENDS custom_music_fixture_data)

  add_test(NAME custom_music_engine_replay
           COMMAND custom_music_test_custom_music ${_lib} ${_work}/sim.bin)
  add_test(NAME custom_music_integration
           COMMAND custom_music_test_integration ${_lib} ${_m}/Ipod_Stream.mus ${_work}/integration)
  add_test(NAME custom_music_library
           COMMAND custom_music_test_library ${_work}/lib ${_lib}/ipod.s3fp ${_m})
  add_test(NAME custom_music_mpf
           COMMAND custom_music_test_mpf ${_m}/ipod.mpf ${_lib}/ipod.s3fp ${_work}/mpf_out.mpf)
  add_test(NAME custom_music_mus_index
           COMMAND custom_music_test_mus ${_m}/Ipod_Stream.mus ${_lib}/ipod.s3fp ${_work}/cpp_index.s3fp)
  set_tests_properties(custom_music_engine_replay custom_music_integration custom_music_library
                       custom_music_mpf custom_music_mus_index PROPERTIES FIXTURES_REQUIRED music_data)
endif()
